author: Top Gear
description:
This is the new Ram 1500 Rumble Bee SRT. It borrows the 777hp 6.2-litre supercharged V8 (that’s the HEMI engine otherwise known as ‘Hellcat’) from the RAM SRT TRX, chops a whole load of length out of the wheelbase, and drops it to the ground to make it the only street-biased muscle truck in the world. Prices will likely start under $100,000, it’ll hit 60mph in 3.4 seconds, the targeted top speed is 170mph, and everyone will see and hear you coming. What’s not to love?

🚗 Ram 1500 Rumble Bee SRT
🎤 Tom Ford

author: Top Gear
description:
The Mercedes-AMG GT 4-Door Coupe is at once many things: the most powerful Mercedes (and AMG) road car ever; AMG’s first-ever series-production electric car; and a replacement for the first-generation (petrol-powered) AMG GT 4-Door Coupe. All which means it’s got to be oh-so-fast, exuberant like the best V8 AMGs but without any engine, and able to go toe-to-toe with the likes of the Porsche Taycan Turbo and BMW M5. Has it got any hope of taking on those rivals, as well as living up to the promise that comes with 1169hp?

🚗 Mercedes-AMG GT 4-Door Coupe
🎤 Tom Ford
